protocol.split: sha256(normalized finish family) modulo 5: 0,1 holdout; 2,3,4 training
protocol.primary: candidate participates in positive net DMarket route with a fixed partner using fully covered bids at both selling legs
protocol.secondary: same with any of nine existing sale assumptions
protocol.primary_fee_hypothesis: CSGO Trader summary is Steam buyer gross; test-only assumption
protocol.sensitivity_fee_hypothesis: CSGO Trader summary is Steam seller net; reconstruct buyer gross for return scoring
protocol.selection: outward,outward,return,return,random exploration, deduplicated; below-threshold/unknown candidates remain in exploration
protocol.control: uniform shuffle of same eligible cohort, same total candidate HTTP budget; common partner cost charged equally
protocol.eligibility: pre-freeze DMarket ask or Steam summary price in [10,1000] cents; no future price used for selection
limitations: Historical cohort was not randomly collected and includes observations from the subsequently reverted Task 4 reader.
Fixed partner test does not search the whole market.
No claims about actual realized profits, future sellability or holding-period price movement.
No production fee qualification or threshold will be changed by this test.

notes: Steam USD 5%/10% fees use separate per-item cent flooring and 1 cent component minima, checked against Steam client code on 2026-09-08 (docs/STEAM_FEE_AUDIT.md); actual account currency and transaction receipt still require confirmation.
DMarket default 10% / 1 cent minimum observed 2026-09-08; first 100 reductions do not prove no item-specific reduction.
Other costs set to zero ONLY for an optimistic screen; actual costs must be supplied before a qualified prediction.
17 days models the cited sequential CS2 waits, excluding uncertain sale/transfer/settlement time; not a guaranteed duration.
Current quotes are conditional proxies for later exits, not reserved fills.
The return review uses a separate 10-day CS2 visibility assumption from the new Steam purchase; actual eligibility and completion remain unverified until observed.
